Game Overview

In Radar, the core idea is straightforward: navigate the high-stakes world of Radar, where split-second decisions determine your fate. Utilize a realistic radar interface to analyze incoming signals, identify threats, and make strategic choices. The game's dynamic unpredictability and immersive military technology create an exhilarating test of your decision-making prowess.
